name: The Taj Nagaraptors
origin: native diapsid theropods of Jambhudweep, the Scale alliance of the Fang vs Scale Wars
notes: Feathered, social raptors who build multi-level earthen Taj Nest-Homes over the spiral tunnels of the burrowing tortoise, which gains warning of predators in return, and ring them with moats and earthworks. They wear clay body pigment and shell-and-feather jewellery, carry carved skull staffs, and are governed by matriarchal councils; the present elder is Taj-Mother Kurukula. They belonged to the Scale alliance in the Fang vs Scale Wars. Reclassified from the bestiary (`fauna_nagaraptor`) to a people by the owner's ruling of 29 September 2026: they have culture, tool use and political agency, so they want portraits and lines, not a plate. See mythology_naga_raptor_fallacy for why they are so often confused with the Naga, to whom they are not related.
